title: Corrections
subtitle: Requested changes to attendance. Originals are never modified: approved corrections add or void events and the day is recomputed.

dialog.title: Request correction
dialog.hint: The request is routed through the approval workflow of the employee's branch.
dialog.autoApproved: Correction approved and queued for application

fields.originalEventHint: Non-voided events from the day before to the day after the attendance date.
fields.enterTime: Enter the time as shown on the clock in {{zone}}.
fields.reasonHint: At least 3 characters. Shown to approvers and kept in the audit log.

typeHint.ADD_PUNCH: Adds a punch the device missed (forgotten badge, device offline).
typeHint.EDIT_PUNCH: Voids an existing punch and adds one at the corrected time.
typeHint.REMOVE_PUNCH: Voids an existing punch (accidental or duplicate).
typeHint.SET_STATUS: Overrides the computed status for the day (e.g. mark present on a training day).

list.emptyHint: Requested corrections appear here with their approval status.

cancel.title: Cancel this correction?
cancel.hint: Only pending corrections can be cancelled. Approvers are notified.
